name: connect-four-live
description: Conecta 4 multijugador en tiempo real con salas privadas por código

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
